definitions.explanation: A period of time equal to thirty minutes or half of one hour.

examples.japanese: {三十分|さんじゅっぷん}{待|ま}った。
{駅|えき}まで{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}かかる。
examples.english: It takes thirty minutes to the station.

examples.japanese: あと{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}で{終|お}わる。
examples.english: It will be over in thirty minutes.

notes:
{三十分|さんじゅっぷん} means thirty minutes or half an hour.

PRONUNCIATION:
Both さんじゅっぷん and さんじっぷん are correct. The さんじっぷん reading follows the traditional sound change pattern, while さんじゅっぷん is more common in modern speech.

ALTERNATIVE EXPRESSIONS:
- {半|はん}: half — used instead of {三十分|さんじゅっぷん} in many contexts
- {三時半|さんじはん}: 3:30 (telling time)
- {一時間半|いちじかんはん}: one and a half hours

COUNTING MINUTES:
The counter {分|ふん} has irregular sound changes:
- 1{分|ぷん} (いっぷん), 3{分|ぷん} (さんぷん), 6{分|ぷん} (ろっぷん), 8{分|ぷん} (はっぷん), 10{分|ぷん} (じゅっぷん)
- 2{分|ふん} (にふん), 5{分|ふん} (ごふん), 7{分|ふん} (ななふん), 9{分|ふん} (きゅうふん)
